title: fix(fields): a json field edits as JSON — shown with JSON.stringify, saved with JSON.parse (objectui#11448)
body:
Fixes #11448

Clause-②: no

## What was wrong

`json` was aliased to `field:code`, the raw-text code editor (`CodeField` renders `value || ''` and emits the textarea text unparsed). Measured on base `990a2d616` through the real record Edit dialog (`ModalForm`, whose body is a real `SchemaRenderer` form), with a click on its real submit button:

| Step | Base `990a2d616` |
|---|---|
| Stored `f_json` object in the edit box | the literal text `[object Object]` |
| Edit to `{"a":1}`, click Update | update payload `{"f_json":"{\"a\":1}"}` — a **string** |
| Unparsable `{"a":` , click Update | sent as the string `"{\"a\":"` |
| Untouched `f_json`, another field edited | `f_json` omitted (the edit diff) |
| Nothing edited, click Update | the whole record, `f_json` the stored **object** unchanged |
| `code` field edited to `y = 2` | `{"f_code":"y = 2"}` |

So the card's open question — does a save that never touches the field send `[object Object]`? — measured **no** on base: the display text is never echoed into the form. That answer is now pinned.

## The fix (triage direction `5946413273`)

1. **`json` resolves to `field:object`** (`packages/fields/src/field-type-alias.ts`) — `ObjectField`, the JSON editor `object` / `composite` / `record` already used. One editor for the four free-form JSON types (`object`, `composite`, `record`, `json`) — `repeater` keeps `field:grid`, and `location` / `address` / `geolocation` keep their own editors; no new widget key, no new registration (the namespaced ratchet test `registered-types-validate-ratchet-10859.test.ts` ran green unchanged). `ObjectField` carries every JSON value, not only objects — array, number, string, boolean, `null` are each shown with `JSON.stringify(value, null, 2)` and parsed back as themselves (pinned), so no second JSON widget was needed.
2. **`code` is unchanged** — still the raw-text editor; the control pin round-trips `{"a":1}` typed into a `code` field as the string it is.
3. **Inline editors keep `json` editable, with the same face.** `FieldEditWidget`'s `EDIT_WIDGETS` now keys `json: ObjectField` directly. Without it, the alias would have resolved `json` to `object`, which is in `INLINE_EXCLUDED_FIELD_TYPES` (containers), and `json` would have dropped out of grid and detail-panel inline editing altogether. The detail panel's `InlineFieldInput` delegates to it, so the inline detail editor and the grid cell show the same JSON face as the record form.

## Changes to `ObjectField` itself — these also reach `object`, `composite` and `record`

Measured on base through the same dialog with a `composite` field: typing `{"a":2}` then `{"a":2` left the box reading the pretty-printed `{ "a": 2 }` while still saying "Invalid JSON", and Update saved `{ a: 2 }`.

- **The draft stays in the box.** The sync effect ran on every draft change and replaced any text that did not parse with the stored value — in an empty field the first `{` vanished at once, so a JSON value could not be typed one character at a time. It now tracks the VALUE (the `LocationField` pattern: adopt an external change only, never overwrite a refused draft, keep the person's own spelling when the draft already denotes the value).
- **A form will not submit unparsable text.** A refused draft never became a form value, so the form still held the last value that parsed and a save sent it (PM mechanism assumption 2 — confirmed). The textarea now carries `setCustomValidity(message)` while refused: the form renderer sets no `noValidate`, so the submit button's click is refused by the browser's constraint validation (box focused, same sentence shown) and **nothing is sent**; correcting the text clears it. No new widget-contract key, no new i18n sentence — the message is the existing `fields.object.invalidJson`.
- **Read-only face prints a stored `0` / `false`** (PM item 3): the old `!value` test drew them as empty. It now uses the json table cell's own floor (`isEmptyValue(value) && !Array.isArray(value)`), so `null` / `undefined` / `""` stay empty and `[]` prints, as `JsonCellRenderer` already does. Same widget, one line.

## Landing sites outside the claim's file surface (named, with the reason)

- `packages/fields/src/FieldEditWidget.tsx` — the `json: ObjectField` inline entry above, plus two stale comments that said json resolves to the code editor. This is the change the PM's pin "the inline detail-panel editor resolves `json` to the same face" needs; without it the alias change turns `json` inline-excluded.
- `packages/plugin-detail/src/InlineFieldInput.tsx` — one comment word (code editor → JSON editor). Comment only, no behaviour.
- `packages/app-shell/src/utils/paramToField.test.ts`, `paramValueShape.test.ts`, `paramValueShape.ts` — the action-parameter dialogs resolve a param's widget through the same alias table. **A `json`-typed action parameter now posts the parsed value instead of the text** (`{"a":1}` arrives as an object). The old param pin asserted `json → code`; it now asserts `json → object`, a new row pins the json param's emitted shape, and the `code` row's note no longer claims json resolves there. No example app in either repo declares a json action param (searched); a param backed by a `json` field previously wrote text into a json column, the same corruption as the form.
- `content/docs/fields/object.mdx` — docs-driven (AGENTS.md rule 2): names `json` among the types this editor serves and replaces "Invalid JSON: maintains current valid value" with the refusal behaviour.
- `packages/plugin-form/src/ModalForm.jsonField-11448.test.tsx` — the new form-level pin lives where the real dialog lives.

One changeset, `@object-ui/fields` patch; it also states the action-param shape change. No separate `plugin-detail` / `app-shell` entry: the comment and note edits ship no behaviour of their own, and the fixed group versions together.

## Pins

Through the real `ModalForm` → `SchemaRenderer` form (`ModalForm.jsonField-11448.test.tsx`): stored object shows pretty-printed JSON; `{"a":1}` submits `{ a: 1 }`; a draft typed one character at a time keeps every keystroke and submits the object; untouched save omits the field / carries the stored object; unparsable text shows the message, marks `aria-invalid`, and the Update click sends nothing — then correcting it sends; a valid draft followed by an unparsable one does not send the stale value; the same for `composite`; `code` control round-trips text.

Widget level (`ObjectField.jsonFace-11448.test.tsx`): `json → field:object`, `code → field:code`; json inline-editable and the inline editor renders the same face; non-object values display and parse; read-only `0` / `false` / `[]` print, `null` / `undefined` / `""` empty; drafts held with and without an echoing host; `validity.customError` set on refusal and cleared on fix; an external value change is still adopted.

Updated: `InlineFieldInput.delegation.test.tsx` (json now shows the stored object as JSON, writes the parsed value, refuses unparsable text inline), `FieldEditWidget.test.ts` (comment), `paramToField.test.ts`, `paramValueShape.test.ts`. `field-type-coverage.test.ts` needed no change: it only asserts `json` maps to a non-`field:text` widget, never `field:code`.

## Reverse verification (predicted before each run)

- **Base (`990a2d616`, new pins applied, source untouched):** 15 red / 66 green across the 4 pin files, exactly the predicted set — the 3 untouched-save and `code`-control pins green on base by measurement, as predicted. Reasons as expected: `expected '[object Object]' to be '{…'`, `expected '{"a":1}' to deeply equal { a: 1 }`, `lost the draft {: expected '' to be '{'`, `expected 'field:code' to be 'field:object'`.
- **Fixed (`cb849c2e1`):** 81/81 green.
- **Ablations on committed head `aab6c634f`**, each landed and restored by `objectstack/scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor hit 1→0, blob changed; restore: blob == HEAD and `git diff HEAD` empty, all five):
  - alias back to `field:code` → 8 red (6 json pins + `paramToField` + `paramValueShape`);
  - old sync effect → 7 red (every held-draft pin, incl. the composite and inline-refusal pins);
  - `setCustomValidity` removed → 4 red (the three nothing-sent pins + the validity pin);
  - `json: ObjectField` inline entry removed → 6 red (incl. `FieldEditWidget.test.ts` and `plugin-grid` `inline-edit-options.test.ts`);
  - read-only floor back to `!value` → 2 red (`0`, `false`).

## Local gates

Heads: the first commit `cb849c2e1` carries every change outside `packages/app-shell`; the second, `aab6c634f`, adds only the three app-shell files and a changeset paragraph. Runs on `cb849c2e1` are therefore unaffected by the second commit; the app-shell pins, the 39-file cross-package run and the ablations ran with the app-shell edits in place.

- (`cb849c2e1`) `pnpm exec vitest run packages/fields/` → `Test Files 230 passed | 1 skipped (231)`, `Tests 3571 passed | 7 skipped` (the skipped file is the pre-existing `dateCell.overdueZone-10183` `skipIf`).
- (`cb849c2e1`) plugin-detail tests naming json / field:code / field:object / ObjectField / CodeField (60 files) → `59 passed | 1 skipped`, `769 passed | 8 skipped`.
- (`cb849c2e1`) plugin-form alias-touching tests + the new pin (12 files) → `12 passed`, `127 passed`.
- (`aab6c634f` tree) Every test outside those three packages that calls the alias, the inline predicates, `FieldEditWidget` or the param resolvers, plus the namespaced ratchet test (39 files) → `39 passed`, `527 passed`.
- (`cb849c2e1`) `pnpm --filter @object-ui/fields type-check`, `@object-ui/plugin-detail`, `@object-ui/plugin-form` → exit 0 (after the scoped dependency-closure build); both new test files confirmed in their packages' `tsconfig.test.json` programs via `--listFiles`.
- (`aab6c634f`) `pnpm check:control-bytes` → `OK`; `pnpm check:new-line-citations` → `VERDICT new-cross-file-line-citations: 0 new citation(s)`; `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` → `11 source file(s) of 4 released package(s) changed, and this change declares 1 changeset(s)`; `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:doc-fences`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:i18n-keys` → OK; governed-surface guard → NOT GOVERNED.
- (`aab6c634f`) ESLint over the 11 changed lintable files → 0 errors (53 warnings, `no-explicit-any` / `only-export-components`; the lint workflow sets no `--max-warnings`). Narrowing proof: the population is the 11 files, counted from `--format json`; `eslint.config.js` enables no type-aware linting (no `parserOptions.project` / `projectService`) and no rule in `eslint-rules/` reads the filesystem, so this diff cannot move any untouched file's verdict.
- NOT MEASURED: `check:doc-snippets` / `check:doc-examples` — PRECONDITION NOT MET (they need a 34-package build); the docs edit touches prose bullets only, no fenced code and no example id. `@object-ui/app-shell` type-check — its dependency closure is most of the tree; the app-shell edit is one string literal and test rows using an existing literal union. Both left to CI.

## Patch round 1 (`59da7c393`, final head)

Prose only, per the seat's REWORK `5947664409`: "every structured type" overclaimed what `ObjectField` serves, so the changeset, `content/docs/fields/object.mdx`, the `ObjectField` docblock and the alias comment now name the free-form JSON types (`object`, `composite`, `record`, `json`), as does this body. The same grep found the overclaim twice more in the new pin's own comments (`ObjectField.jsonFace-11448.test.tsx`); those two comments are corrected too. No code or assertion changed. Re-run through the verify lock: `ObjectField.jsonFace-11448` + `field-type-coverage` + `FieldEditWidget.test` → `Test Files 3 passed (3)`, `Tests 121 passed`; `check:changeset-claims` → OK; `check:control-bytes`, `check:new-line-citations`, `check-changeset-presence` → OK. No test asserts any of the changed strings.

## Acceptance notes (out of scope, not changed here)

- The detail panel's inline save bar has no form element, so the constraint-validation refusal cannot block it: with a valid intermediate draft followed by an unparsable one, its Save would send that intermediate value. The box still shows the refusal, and no string is ever written. The same gap already holds for `LocationField` refusals on that surface (and in the record form, whose refusals never set validity). A host-level fix — the save bar refusing while any control in the editing section is invalid — would close both.
- With nothing edited, the edit dialog's update carries every field (measured above). Not a defect for json (the stored object is sent unchanged); noted only because the card asked about untouched saves.
- A record the old editor already saved as a string now shows as a JSON string literal (`"{\"a\":1}"`), which is the value it holds; retyping it as JSON and saving stores the object.

Implemented by the os-dev seat for PM session `https://claude.ai/code/session_01YLg8XqWGJ785fwQ5v4pH37`.
